description: Dependency-free Go CLI for verifiable project documentation and static documentation portals.
rules: Use the installed toudocu binary for CLI commands; use go run ./cmd/toudocu only when developing Toudocu in its source repository.
Treat $toudocu commands as prompts for the installed skill, not as shell commands.
Choose a document type from the reader's question; use ordinary Markdown when stable IDs and validated relationships are unnecessary.
Read explicitly linked standards and runbooks before changing files, then run toudocu check for the whole documentation root.
Run task verify --run only after explicit authorization in a trusted repository.
